set.body:
Review finding C1 (post-fix cold review, 2026-09-17), verified 2026-09-18 by tracing every caller.

THE DEFECT. The Sherlock annotation-to-playback crosswalk that actually runs bypasses core's mapping vocabulary entirely.
- Production path: `@main sherlockRecallMap` (embed-bench/.../bench/sherlock/SherlockRecallMapping.scala:233) -> `SherlockAnnotations.parse(bytes)` with its DEFAULT manifest `MediaManifest.nn2017` (corpus-intake/.../SherlockAnnotations.scala:269) -> `locusFor`, which computes `rawSeconds.toLong * part.ticksPerSecond` by hand (:240-241).
- `MediaManifest.nn2017` (:45-67) is a hand-transcribed literal block: durations, tick rate, run boundary, row count, part ids and three byte hashes.
- `TimebaseRepair.clockRepairs` -> `ClockRepair` has ZERO production callers; every reference is a test. Its Scaladoc (TimebaseRepair.scala:165-166) says it gives core's mapping vocabulary "its first production caller". False.
- `ClockRepair.projectRunLocalSeconds` (core/.../source.scala:1441) does the same arithmetic, seconds x scale + offset, but exact, axis-checked and receipt-carrying, and its no-repair overload (:1451) REFUSES. That refusal is the design's point, and it guards nothing because production goes around it.

WHY INTEGRATE, NOT DELETE. Same numbers, stronger guarantees: the refusal, the axis check and the provenance exist only if production goes through the class. The review fixes landed at b464ceaf are what make routing production through TimebaseRepair viable -- before them it ignored the record's formula, mapping and offset. Deleting is defensible (the literals are now test-bound to the JSON) but abandons the one real production use of core's mapping vocabulary, which was the headline goal of epic bd-01M2R747J0SCHRFH9BF70TWT4S. Existing vocabulary, not new: no ADR needed (SD5).

OVERLAP -- read before starting:
- bd-01M2TAC80YRK5JFNKTT7B7CAQN (Phase 2 D1B: typed source view with exact PlaybackInterval sets) will CONSUME this crosswalk. If it lands first it inherits the literals. Recommend this land first, or D1B take it as a blocker; that is the mapper plan owner's call.
- bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM (Phase 2 recall-map command) will replace sherlockRecallMap. Hence the loader child is a reusable function, not an edit to a command being retired.
- bd-01M1CQ2H7VPSKRT02M5H7HN1K6 (CODE RED, doing) item B0 owns Sherlock artifact-specific admission and "a follow-on artifact-binding receipt" for media, annotation and timebase identities. The admission-hash decision belongs with B0.

Children carry the steps. Order: docfix (any time); baseline BEFORE any code change; record; locus; receipts; loader; hash decision applied; verify.

Data policy, rule 14(d): the real annotation table and any output carrying stimulus prose or recall words stay under the git-ignored data root. What is committed is digests and content-free receipts only.
set.title: Sherlock crosswalk: route production through ClockRepair and derive the manifest from the record (review finding C1)
